description: This script checks that all symbols listed in 'header_only_apis.txt' are tested in corresponding C++ test files to ensure they are header-only APIs. It scans test files for symbol usage and reports untested symbols.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration of severity levels for lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: Data structure representing a lint message with details about the issue.

methods.name: find_matched_symbols
methods.description: Finds symbols in test files matching a regex pattern, used to verify symbol testing coverage.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Checks the header_only_apis.txt file to ensure all listed symbols are tested in test files.
